AddChoiceOp.description: Add a choice, its id kept, at ``index`` (default: the end).
AddChoiceOp.title: AddChoiceOp

AddFieldOp.description:
Add a question to a page, or (with ``group_id``) into a repeating
group, where it is asked once per item.
AddFieldOp.title: AddFieldOp

AddGroupOp.description:
Create a repeating group on a page: child questions respondents fill
once per item ("Applicant 1", "Applicant 2", ...), between ``min_items``
and ``max_items`` times.
AddGroupOp.title: AddGroupOp

CalculationFormat.description:
How a calculated field shows its value: a number with ``decimals``
places, an amount of ``currency`` (ISO 4217 code, EUR by default), a
percentage (0.25 shows as 25%) or plain text. Display only: the stored
value is the computed one, unrounded.
CalculationFormat.title: CalculationFormat

DateRule.description:
One constraint on the answer of a ``date`` question, stored at
``properties.date_rules``: the chosen date must be ``comparison``
(before / after / on or before / on or after) a fixed ``date``
(``YYYY-MM-DD``), ``today``, or the answer of another date question
(``field_id``). Dates are compared as calendar dates, never as instants.

A rule on another question applies only when that question is answered
and not hidden by logic. Inside a repeating group a rule may only use a
sibling of the same group (it then means "this item's answer"); outside
a group it may not use a group's questions. Cross-question checks need
the whole form: see :func:`date_rule_problems`. The webapp's twin is
``webapp/src/utils/date-rules.ts``.
DateRule.title: DateRule

DateRuleSpec.description:
A date question's constraint: its answer must be ``comparison`` a
fixed ``date`` (YYYY-MM-DD), ``today`` or the answer of another date
question (``fieldId``; inside a repeating group a sibling of the same
group, outside a group never a group's question).
DateRuleSpec.title: DateRuleSpec

DuplicatePageOp.description:
Clone a page with all its fields (fresh ids everywhere). In-page logic
references are remapped to the cloned fields.
DuplicatePageOp.title: DuplicatePageOp

EditorField.description: A question or page as the form editor holds it (camelCase), read and checked as a whole-form save reads it.

EndingPatch.description:
What add_ending / update_ending set. ``""`` clears a text; the name
and the link are checked when the op is applied, so one bad value fails
alone.
EndingPatch.title: EndingPatch

FieldLogic.description:
v2 conditional-visibility rule stored on a field at ``properties.logic``.
Kept as plain strings (action ``SHOW``/``HIDE``, operator ``AND``/``OR``,
comparison enum values) so it round-trips the webapp shape verbatim without
enum-casing coupling. See webapp ``utils/conditional-logic.ts``.
FieldLogic.title: FieldLogic

FieldLogicCondition.description: A single condition in a v2 field conditional-visibility rule.
FieldLogicCondition.title: FieldLogicCondition

FieldPatch.description:
Partial update of an existing field. Absent = unchanged. The
``*_items`` / ``item_*`` / ``export_layout`` keys only apply to
repeating groups.
FieldPatch.title: FieldPatch

FieldPosition.description: Flow-view canvas coordinates of a page node. Cosmetic only.
FieldPosition.title: FieldPosition

FieldValidationPatch.description:
Answer constraints of a question. Absent = unchanged, null = cleared.
``preset`` picks a named pattern (VALIDATION_PRESETS); ``pattern`` is
a regular expression of your own.
FieldValidationPatch.title: FieldValidationPatch

FormSettingsPatch.description:
AI-editable form settings — the Form tab's metadata.

Deliberately a SUBSET of SettingsPatchDto: trust-layer text and
response-behaviour toggles. Distribution/visibility (hidden, private,
pinned, custom URL, close date) stays human-only — an ambiguous chat
instruction must never unpublish or hide a form.
FormSettingsPatch.title: FormSettingsPatch

InsertFieldOp.description:
Insert a complete question, its id kept, on a page at ``index`` (or,
with ``group_id``, into that repeating group).
InsertFieldOp.title: InsertFieldOp

InsertPageOp.description:
Insert a complete page (type ``slide``, its questions included), ids
kept, at ``index`` among the question pages.
InsertPageOp.title: InsertPageOp

LogicConditionSpec.description:
One condition of a visibility rule / page jump. Mirrors the builder's
logic editor exactly: choice conditions carry the choice LABEL, yes/no
carries "Yes"/"No" (see webapp condition-editor-shared.tsx).
LogicConditionSpec.title: LogicConditionSpec

MoveFieldOp.description:
Move a question within its page, to another page (``to_page_id``)
or into a repeating group (``to_group_id``), at ``index`` (default: the
end).
MoveFieldOp.title: MoveFieldOp

MovePageOp.description:
Move a question page to ``index`` (0-based among the question
pages; past the end = last).
MovePageOp.title: MovePageOp

NewFieldSpec.description: What the AI supplies to create a field.
NewFieldSpec.title: NewFieldSpec

PageJump.description:
v2 page-jump / branching rule stored on a slide at ``properties.jumps``.
``target`` is a slide id or the sentinel ``__SUBMIT__``. Plain strings, same
rationale as :class:`FieldLogic`.

``ending_id`` (only with ``__SUBMIT__``): the ending shown after the
submission; without it, or when that ending is gone, the form's default
ending. Kept beside the target rather than in it, so a reader that does
not know endings still sees "submit" and ends the path there.
PageJump.title: PageJump

RemoveEndingOp.description:
Remove an ending (never the last one). Jumps that chose it show the
default ending instead.
RemoveEndingOp.title: RemoveEndingOp

RepeatSettings.description:
Makes a ``group`` field repeatable: respondents fill its child questions
once per item (one block per applicant, employer, ...), between
``min_items`` and ``max_items`` times. ``item_label`` names one item
("Applicant") and labels the add button; ``item_title`` is an optional
header template that may pipe a sibling answer (``{{field:<child id>}}``).
``export_layout`` overrides the default export shape (columns per item
when ``max_items <= 5``, else a separate table of rows).
RepeatSettings.title: RepeatSettings

ReplaceFieldOp.description: Replace the question with ``field.id`` by ``field``, where it is.
ReplaceFieldOp.title: ReplaceFieldOp

SetEndingsOp.description:
The form's endings as a whole, ids kept (each as a whole-form save
takes it). Page jumps are left as they are: one that names an ending no
longer listed shows as broken, and blocks publishing, until it is
changed. An empty list removes the endings.
SetEndingsOp.title: SetEndingsOp

SetFieldLogicOp.description:
Conditional visibility on a field ("show X only when Y = ..."). The
rule lives on the TARGET field; conditions reference earlier answers.
``logic: null`` clears the rule.
SetFieldLogicOp.title: SetFieldLogicOp

SetFormLanguageOp.description:
The language the form's own text is written in (its title,
questions, choices): a short BCP 47 tag, one of FORM_LANGUAGES
(common/models/standard_form.py), any case. ``language`` null or ""
clears it. Respondent pages mark the form's text with it, so screen
readers and browsers read it in that language.

Kept on the form itself (``settings.language``), not on the workspace's
form settings that update_form_settings changes: it is part of the form,
shared by every workspace the form is in and copied into each published
version. The tag is checked when the op is applied, so an unknown one
fails alone instead of the whole turn.

language.description: One of: nl, en, de, fr, es, it, pt, pl, da, sv, nb, fi; null clears it.
language.title: Language

SetFormLanguageOp.title: SetFormLanguageOp

SetHiddenFieldsOp.description:
The form's hidden fields (URL parameter names), as a whole. Pipes of
names no longer listed are removed from question titles.
SetHiddenFieldsOp.title: SetHiddenFieldsOp

SetPageJumpsOp.description:
Branching: after this page, jump to a target page (or submit) when the
conditions match; first matching jump wins, no match = next page.
``jumps: null`` clears.
SetPageJumpsOp.title: SetPageJumpsOp

SetQuestionNumberingOp.description: Number the questions of one page (``page_id``) or of every page.
SetQuestionNumberingOp.title: SetQuestionNumberingOp

SetSectionTitleOp.description:
Name a question page's section (``properties.sectionTitle``): what
the Leaflet section bar and the welcome page's contents list show for
the page, before its opening heading and its first question. The page is
given by ``page_id`` or by ``page_index`` (0-based, among the question
pages, the ``index`` of the form snapshot). ``title`` null or "" clears
it. The welcome page and the ending have no section title.

The length is checked when the op is applied, not when it is parsed, so
one long title fails alone instead of the whole turn.
SetSectionTitleOp.title: SetSectionTitleOp

SetThemePresetOp.description:
Dress the form in one of the theme presets (constants/themes.py), by
name (any case), as the builder's theme picker does: the preset's
colours, no background, and its own style if it has one (Leaflet), else
the form's current style. ``style`` sets the style instead
(constants/themes.py THEME_STYLES). Both are checked when the op is
applied, so an unknown name fails alone instead of the whole turn.
SetThemePresetOp.title: SetThemePresetOp

StandardFormField.description: Data transfer object for Fields in a standard form.
StandardFormField.title: StandardFormField

titleFont.description: Face of titles and question labels. Absent: the text face (or the style's own title face).
titleFont.title: Titlefont

bodyFont.description: Face of everything else respondents read. Absent: public-sans.
bodyFont.title: Bodyfont

dataFont.description: Face of data such as the submission number. Absent: the app's mono face.
dataFont.title: Datafont

titleWidth.description: Width of display titles: expanded is 125% on a face with a width axis (archivo).
titleWidth.title: Titlewidth

radius.description: Corners of fields, option cards and buttons: sharp 0, soft 6px, round 16px. Absent: the style's own.
radius.title: Radius

buttonStyle.description: Absent: filled. outlined: the page colour with an edge and text that pass contrast. pill: filled and fully rounded.
buttonStyle.title: Buttonstyle

highlight.description: The chosen answer, the 'why we ask' and 'optional' notes and, where it reads at 3:1 on the page, the focus ring. Absent: secondary.
highlight.title: Highlight

ThemeBackground.description:
Optional page-ground decoration. Field names are camelCase on purpose:
the webapp sends the theme verbatim inside the form JSON (no camel<->snake
conversion happens for this nested object), and the same shape round-trips
back out. Lenient here — strict validation lives on the workspace
theme-presets endpoint where themes are authored.
ThemeBackground.title: ThemeBackground

UpdateLogoOp.description: The logo's settings. The logo itself only changes by an upload.
UpdateLogoOp.title: UpdateLogoOp

UpdateThemeOp.description:
Replace the form's theme: its colours, background and style and,
optionally, its type and shape (``titleFont``, ``bodyFont``,
``dataFont``, ``titleWidth``, ``radius``, ``buttonStyle``) and
``highlight`` colour. Those are checked when the op is applied: each is
absent or one of its listed values, and the highlight is #rrggbb.
UpdateThemeOp.title: UpdateThemeOp
